causal_contract.alignment: PASS: weights are indexed in unshifted label coordinates and shifted beside the same labels; each selected label is predicted by logits at index-1.

code_pair_effect.conclusion: Code-Pair preserves total slot mass and the 75/25 demo/query split, but doubles the wrong cell pair: implemented columns 0/1 rather than documented columns 1/2.

confirmed_code_pair_defect.boundary: This confirms a supervision-locator defect; it does not by itself quantify how much of the V2 generalization failure it caused.
confirmed_code_pair_defect.impact: Implemented pair cannot distinguish Count 2 from Count 3 and overweights the always-foreground color/output-construction cell while omitting the third run cell.

limits: Equal-Slot masking, causal shifting, and mass normalization pass. The Code-Pair semantic locator defect is confirmed, but its causal effect size is unknown without a controlled experiment.

mask_contract.assistant_turns: all assistant framing, grid digits/newlines, and end token supervised
mask_contract.interpretation: This is intentional all-assistant CE, not query-only CE.

nominal_equal_slot_objective_mass.definition: Each slot is independently mean-normalized, then contributes 1/4 of its optimizer-step objective. Fractions below are scalar objective coefficients before gradient norms/directions.

raw_supervised_token_exposure.warning: Raw token counts are exposure/accounting, not Equal-Slot objective weights.

scope: Committed serializer, Equal-Slot loss, Code-Pair locator/weights, and connected-component worker call path; no model forward/backward.
